quote: The following regulations pertain to the operation of vehicles within a roundabout: The operator of a vehicle entering a roundabout shall yield the right-of-way to vehicles already in the roundabout and wait for a gap in traffic before entering.

activation.condition: An operator is entering a roundabout while vehicles are already within it.

obligation.description: Yield right-of-way to vehicles already in the roundabout and wait for a gap in traffic before entering.

timing.description: Yield and wait before the entering vehicle crosses the roundabout boundary.

judgment_calls_needed.note: Original map, actor identity and occupancy timing must establish precedence.
Source frames bracket the entry; no statutory sufficient-gap cutoff is declared.
